title: PONPONPON
description: Debut single by Japanese singer Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, written and produced by Yasutaka Nakata (capsule). The music video was directed by Jun Tamukai, with art direction by Sebastian Masuda (6%DOKIDOKI), styling by Kumiko Iijima and choreography by air:man; Warner Music Japan uploaded it to YouTube on 2011-07-16 and it became a viral hit, passing one million views in under three weeks. The single was released on 2011-07-20 and later appeared on the EP Moshi Moshi Harajuku (2011-08-17) and the album Pamyu Pamyu Revolution (2012). Its psychedelic kawaii/decora imagery made it a defining example of Harajuku pop culture and one of the most-viewed Japanese music videos, with more than 200 million views on YouTube.
